anchors.method: log-log linear fit on colony-size CCDF (pre-Clauset 2009); Iwata 2000 mass-action coagulation theory + Brú 2003 empirical fit

interpretation: Aggregation kinetics requires TWO scaling laws acting at different scales: (1) per-plaque size distribution is power-law (Smoluchowski coagulation), (2) cross-population total-burden distribution is lognormal (multiplicative-stochastic growth at the patient scale; Hyman 2008). A single-layer cross-section test for PL was the wrong test — the lognormal cross-section IS the expected signature, not a refutation. v0.4 originally INCONCLUSIVE; v0.5 multilayer PASS-CONFIRMED if both layers' constraints satisfied.
